_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Celebrations in Smoke#000.dst: {p} 近くの [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にある掲示板を読む。

Celebrations in Smoke#001.src: The board is plastered full of old notices, but a newer one catches your eye:
Celebrations in Smoke#001.dst: 古い張り紙だらけの掲示板に、新しい一枚が目に留まる：
Celebrations in Smoke#001.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#002.src: THE FESTIVAL OF THE WICKER HAS RETURNED AGAIN! JOIN THE ENTIRE MISTWOODS IN ALDWELL FOR THE FESTIVITIES
Celebrations in Smoke#002.dst: Wicker 祭が再びやって来た！ ALDWELL に集い、MISTWOODS 総出で祝おう
Celebrations in Smoke#002.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#003.src: It looks like the festival starts tomorrow afternoon. Would you like to attend?
Celebrations in Smoke#003.dst: 祭りは明日の午後から始まるようだ。参加する？
Celebrations in Smoke#003.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#005.src: Enter the Festival of the Wicker at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Celebrations in Smoke#006.src: Welcome to the Festival of the Wicker!
Celebrations in Smoke#006.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#007.dst: メダリオンを見せてもらえるか？
Celebrations in Smoke#007.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#008.src: Then you cannot be trusted. Leave.
Celebrations in Smoke#008.dst: では信用できない。去れ。
Celebrations in Smoke#008.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#009.src: Thank you, enjoy the festival! You can grab a mask inside.
Celebrations in Smoke#009.dst: ありがとう、祭りを楽しんで！仮面は中でもらえるよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#009.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#010.src: The board doesn't have anything else on it that catches your eye.
Celebrations in Smoke#010.dst: 掲示板には他に目を引くものはない。
Celebrations in Smoke#010.speaker: Bulletin Board

Celebrations in Smoke#011.src: We can't let you in without seeing your medallion!
Celebrations in Smoke#011.dst: メダリオンを見せてもらわないと入れられない！
Celebrations in Smoke#011.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#012.dst: 予備の仮面を受け取る。

Celebrations in Smoke#013.src: Once you get inside, make sure to put your mask on.
Celebrations in Smoke#013.dst: 中に入ったら、必ず仮面をつけてくれ。
Celebrations in Smoke#013.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#015.src: I hope you're enjoying the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#015.dst: 祭りを楽しんでくれているといいが！
Celebrations in Smoke#015.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#016.src: Welcome to Festival of the Wicker's premier food stall!
Celebrations in Smoke#016.dst: Wicker 祭いちばんの屋台へようこそ！
Celebrations in Smoke#016.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#018.dst: ウサギのローストをどうぞ！
Celebrations in Smoke#018.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#020.dst: フォーチュンクッキーをどうぞ！
Celebrations in Smoke#020.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#022.src: 'A clan member you hate will soon change your life.'
Celebrations in Smoke#022.dst: 「嫌いな氏族の者が、じきに人生を変えるだろう。」
Celebrations in Smoke#022.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#023.dst: 「三匹連れの狐は吉報をもたらす。」
Celebrations in Smoke#023.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#024.src: 'A new love will soon enter your life!'
Celebrations in Smoke#024.dst: 「新しい恋がまもなく訪れる！」
Celebrations in Smoke#024.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#025.src: 'Do not forget the danger of outsiders or someday you will have great trouble.'
Celebrations in Smoke#025.dst: 「よそ者の危険を忘れるな。いずれ大きな災いとなる。」
Celebrations in Smoke#025.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#026.src: 'Avoid the forest floor, a great calamity awaits you.'
Celebrations in Smoke#026.dst: 「林床を避けよ。大いなる災厄が待っている。」
Celebrations in Smoke#026.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#027.src: 'Love with the same passion that you hate or both will consume you.'
Celebrations in Smoke#027.dst: 「憎むのと同じ熱で愛せ。さもなくば両方に呑まれる。」
Celebrations in Smoke#027.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#028.src: 'Your suspicion which no one else believes will someday be right.'
Celebrations in Smoke#028.dst: 「誰も信じないその疑いは、いつか正しいと分かる。」
Celebrations in Smoke#028.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#030.src: 'Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem.'
Celebrations in Smoke#030.dst: 「身近な者に用心せよ！見かけどおりとは限らない。」
Celebrations in Smoke#030.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#031.src: 'Mist is pretty from a distance, but do not lose yourself in it.'
Celebrations in Smoke#031.dst: 「霧は遠目には美しいが、その中で迷うな。」
Celebrations in Smoke#031.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#032.src: 'Restrain your curiosity, especially around odd beatles.'
Celebrations in Smoke#032.dst: 「好奇心を抑えよ。特に妙な甲虫のそばでは。」
Celebrations in Smoke#032.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#033.src: 'You will live an uneventful life, unremarkable in every way.'
Celebrations in Smoke#033.dst: 「平凡で何事もない、取り柄のない一生を送るだろう。」
Celebrations in Smoke#033.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#034.src: 'A river will both give and take what you love most.'
Celebrations in Smoke#034.dst: 「川が、最も愛するものを与え、そして奪う。」
Celebrations in Smoke#034.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#035.src: 'Make the most of your life, it will come to a nasty end.'
Celebrations in Smoke#035.dst: 「人生を楽しめ。ろくな最期を迎えないのだから。」
Celebrations in Smoke#035.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#036.src: 'Beware an uncomfortable encounter with an eagle.'
Celebrations in Smoke#036.dst: 「鷲との気まずい出会いに用心せよ。」
Celebrations in Smoke#036.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#037.src: 'Your suspicion which no one else believes will someday be right.'
Celebrations in Smoke#037.dst: 「誰も信じないその疑いは、いつか正しいと分かる。」
Celebrations in Smoke#037.speaker: Fortune Cookie

Celebrations in Smoke#038.src: I'm sorry, I'm still setting up, maybe I'll have something at a later date.
Celebrations in Smoke#038.dst: すみません、まだ準備中です。後日なら何かあるかも。
Celebrations in Smoke#038.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#039.dst: トークンの引き換えですか？
Celebrations in Smoke#039.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#040.src: What would you like to buy?
Celebrations in Smoke#040.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#041.src: How many would you like to buy?
Celebrations in Smoke#041.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#042.src: There is your token, enjoy the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#042.dst: トークンです。祭りを楽しんで！
Celebrations in Smoke#042.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#043.src: There are your tokens, enjoy the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#043.dst: トークンをどうぞ。祭りを楽しんで！
Celebrations in Smoke#043.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#044.src: There are your tokens, enjoy the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#044.dst: トークンをどうぞ。祭りを楽しんで！
Celebrations in Smoke#044.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#045.src: You can come get some at any time during the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#045.dst: 祭りの間ならいつでも取りに来てください。
Celebrations in Smoke#045.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#046.src: Make sure you do before the festival ends!
Celebrations in Smoke#046.dst: 祭りが終わる前に来てくださいね！
Celebrations in Smoke#046.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#047.src: I'm afraid you can't afford that.
Celebrations in Smoke#047.dst: 残念ですが、足りませんね。
Celebrations in Smoke#047.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#048.src: H-hi. I, um, hope you're having as good a time as I am.
Celebrations in Smoke#048.dst: こ、こんにちは。え、ええと、あなたも楽しんでるといいな。
Celebrations in Smoke#048.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#050.src: It really is fun to finally get a chance to relax.
Celebrations in Smoke#050.dst: やっと一息つけるのは本当に楽しい。
Celebrations in Smoke#050.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#051.src: I love being a part of the Kalkalrah clan, but at times like this it's nice to have the chance to be alone.
Celebrations in Smoke#051.dst: Kalkalrah 氏族の一員でいるのは好きだけど、こういう時は一人になれるのもいい。
Celebrations in Smoke#051.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#052.src: Staring across the pond, enjoying the festival, surrounded by people I love.
Celebrations in Smoke#052.dst: 池の向こうを眺め、祭りを楽しみ、愛する人たちに囲まれて。
Celebrations in Smoke#052.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#053.src: It's a sort of quiet, safe calm. One unlike the rest of the year.
Celebrations in Smoke#053.dst: 静かで、安全な穏やかさ。一年の他の時とは違う。
Celebrations in Smoke#053.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#054.src: It's the festival again! And you know what that means...
Celebrations in Smoke#054.dst: また祭りだ！つまり、分かるよな…
Celebrations in Smoke#054.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#055.src: Green tea!!! I never know how to get this stuff outside the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#055.dst: 緑茶！！！祭り以外でどこで手に入るのか、さっぱりだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#055.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#056.src: I'm going to spend all night standing right here, drinking as much of it as I can!
Celebrations in Smoke#056.dst: 今夜は一晩中ここに立って、飲めるだけ飲むぞ！
Celebrations in Smoke#056.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#057.src: Do you want to watch the next round of fox races?
Celebrations in Smoke#057.dst: 次の狐レース、見ていきますか？
Celebrations in Smoke#057.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#058.src: Get ready then, because they're ready to go!
Celebrations in Smoke#058.dst: では準備を。狐たちはもう走る気満々です！
Celebrations in Smoke#058.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#059.src: The rules are simple: you pick the fox you think will win a race around the wickerman and back.
Celebrations in Smoke#059.dst: ルールは簡単。ウィッカーマンを一周して戻る競走で、勝ちそうな狐を選ぶだけです。
Celebrations in Smoke#059.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#060.src: Costs {~} tokens to enter, you get your tokens back if your pick is {~}nd, double it if it gets first.
Celebrations in Smoke#060.dst: 参加は {~} トークン。選んだ狐が {~} 位なら返却、1位なら倍です。
Celebrations in Smoke#060.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#061.src: I'll give you a banner you can use to cheer your fox on. It should be helpful, although sometimes they can get a bit overwhelmed.
Celebrations in Smoke#061.dst: 応援用の旗を渡します。役に立つはずですが、狐が圧倒されてしまうこともあります。
Celebrations in Smoke#061.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#062.src: Best of luck if you do choose to play!
Celebrations in Smoke#062.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#063.src: We'll be holding more races all night if you change your mind!
Celebrations in Smoke#063.dst: 気が変わったら、今夜はまだ何度もレースがありますよ！
Celebrations in Smoke#063.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#064.src: I'm afraid you don't have enough tokens to watch a fox race.
Celebrations in Smoke#064.dst: 残念ですが、狐レースに必要なトークンが足りません。
Celebrations in Smoke#064.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#065.src: If you need more, you can buy some at the Reward Merchant to the east.
Celebrations in Smoke#065.dst: 足りなければ、東の報酬商人で買えますよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#065.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#067.src: Wow! Your support for your fox was really impressive.
Celebrations in Smoke#067.dst: わあ！狐への応援、本当に見事でした。
Celebrations in Smoke#067.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#068.src: You've easily earned these tokens. Enjoy!
Celebrations in Smoke#068.dst: このトークンは文句なしの勝ち取りです。どうぞ！
Celebrations in Smoke#068.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#069.src: Looks like you helped your fox want to win!
Celebrations in Smoke#069.dst: あなたの応援で、狐もやる気が出たようですね！
Celebrations in Smoke#069.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#070.src: It just wasn't strong enough to come in first.
Celebrations in Smoke#070.dst: ただ、1位になるには力が足りなかった。
Celebrations in Smoke#070.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#071.src: Second's not bad though! You've earned these tokens back.
Celebrations in Smoke#071.dst: でも2位も悪くない！トークンはお返しします。
Celebrations in Smoke#071.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#072.src: Aww, it looks like your fox didn't manage to pull off a win.
Celebrations in Smoke#072.dst: ああ、狐は勝てなかったようですね。
Celebrations in Smoke#072.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#073.src: Maybe one of you needs to put in a bit more effort next time?
Celebrations in Smoke#073.dst: 次はどちらかがもう少し頑張らないとですね？
Celebrations in Smoke#073.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#074.src: Hmm, in the last race, blue looked like it was going to...
Celebrations in Smoke#074.dst: うーん、前のレースで青はもう少しで…
Celebrations in Smoke#074.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#075.src: Oh, hi. Don't worry about me, I'm just analyzing the performances of the last few races.
Celebrations in Smoke#075.dst: ああ、どうも。気にしないで。前の数レースの走りを分析してるだけだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#075.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#076.src: It's nothing you'd be able to understand anyway, so don't worry about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#076.dst: どうせ君には理解できない話だから、気にするな。
Celebrations in Smoke#076.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#077.src: Isn't it nice to see kids having fun?
Celebrations in Smoke#077.dst: 子どもが楽しそうだと嬉しいでしょう？
Celebrations in Smoke#077.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#078.src: I try to lighten his life when I can, but it's so hard to some days.
Celebrations in Smoke#078.dst: できる時はあの子の毎日を明るくしたいけど、難しい日もあるの。
Celebrations in Smoke#078.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#079.src: That's why I love the festival. Makes my job easier!
Celebrations in Smoke#079.dst: だから祭りが好き。仕事が楽になるから！
Celebrations in Smoke#079.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#080.src: He can entertain himself, I can watch for danger.
Celebrations in Smoke#080.dst: あの子は勝手に遊べるし、私は危険を見張れる。
Celebrations in Smoke#080.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#081.src: I love when the festival finally comes around again!
Celebrations in Smoke#081.dst: お祭りがまた来るのが大好き！
Celebrations in Smoke#081.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#082.src: The festival is a great time to hang out with friends, away from anyone who might want to intrude on us.
Celebrations in Smoke#082.dst: 祭りは、邪魔しに来そうな連中から離れて、仲間とつるむのにいい時だ。
Celebrations in Smoke#082.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#083.src: Oh, it's so kind of you to come and see me.
Celebrations in Smoke#083.dst: まあ、会いに来てくれるなんて優しいねぇ。
Celebrations in Smoke#083.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#084.src: I'm much too weak to ride the ziplines around town anymore so I appreciate any company I can get.
Celebrations in Smoke#084.dst: もう体が弱って、町のジップラインには乗れなくてね。誰か来てくれるだけでありがたいよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#084.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#085.src: Even so, I love getting to sit on my porch and look down at all the happy people around this time of year.
Celebrations in Smoke#085.dst: それでも、この時期は玄関先に座って、下の楽しそうな人たちを眺めるのが好きなのさ。
Celebrations in Smoke#085.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#087.src: It's a lot of work to put on, but it's always worth it to see everyone together.
Celebrations in Smoke#087.dst: 準備は大変ですが、皆が集まる姿を見ると、いつも報われます。
Celebrations in Smoke#087.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#088.src: This is the only time of year a lot of us get to relax, we have to take what we can get.
Celebrations in Smoke#088.dst: 多くの者にとって一年で唯一くつろげる時。存分に味わわねばなりません。
Celebrations in Smoke#088.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#089.src: Hm... do you hear that? That crackling... and that smell... is that...?
Celebrations in Smoke#089.dst: む…聞こえますか？あのパチパチという音…この匂い…まさか…？
Celebrations in Smoke#089.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#091.src: Quick! Somebody run to the pond to get some water and put out the fire!
Celebrations in Smoke#091.dst: 急いで！誰か池から水を汲んで、火を消してください！
Celebrations in Smoke#091.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#093.dst: 急いで、火を消してください！
Celebrations in Smoke#093.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#094.src: Thank you so much for your quick action. I hope you don't mind, but I'll need some more help.
Celebrations in Smoke#094.dst: 素早い行動に感謝します。恐縮ですが、もう少し力を貸してください。
Celebrations in Smoke#094.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#096.src: Can any of you show me a medallion?
Celebrations in Smoke#096.dst: 誰かメダリオンを見せられますか？
Celebrations in Smoke#096.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#097.src: Just as I thought. All of you will be held until we can figure out the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#097.dst: やはり。真相が分かるまで、全員拘束します。
Celebrations in Smoke#097.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#098.src: Into that house, all three of you.
Celebrations in Smoke#098.dst: 三人とも、あの家に入りなさい。
Celebrations in Smoke#098.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#099.src: There will have to be an investigation into this incident and you're one person I'm positive didn't start the fire.
Celebrations in Smoke#099.dst: この件は調べねばなりません。火を放っていないと確信できるのは、あなただけです。
Celebrations in Smoke#099.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#100.dst: どうぞ、ついてきてください。
Celebrations in Smoke#100.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#101.src: Follow the Festival Organizer into the house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Celebrations in Smoke#101.dst: 祭りの主催者について [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の家に入る。

Celebrations in Smoke#102.src: Thank you so much for your help again, without your assistance the festival would have been ruined.
Celebrations in Smoke#102.dst: 改めてありがとうございます。あなたがいなければ、祭りは台無しでした。
Celebrations in Smoke#102.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#103.src: I cannot express my gratitude more effusely, but I'm afraid I must ask more of you.
Celebrations in Smoke#103.dst: 感謝してもしきれませんが、さらにお願いしなければなりません。
Celebrations in Smoke#103.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#104.src: You see, I do not believe that fire was set by an accident. There's a vandal in our midst and I fear the worst.
Celebrations in Smoke#104.dst: あの火は事故ではないと思うのです。この中に破壊者がいる。最悪の事態を恐れています。
Celebrations in Smoke#104.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#105.src: Just as generations ago, when our ancestors first exposed and immolated the changeling threat that we are supposed to be celebrating today, we must remain vigilant!
Celebrations in Smoke#105.dst: 何世代も前、祖先がチェンジリングの脅威を暴き、焼き払った。今日祝うのはその出来事。我らは今も警戒を怠ってはならない！
Celebrations in Smoke#105.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#106.src: Unfortunately... the festival has always been a time when that vigilance has lapsed a bit. We have an unwelcome attendee.
Celebrations in Smoke#106.dst: 残念ながら…祭りの間はその警戒が緩みがちです。招かれざる客が紛れ込んでいます。
Celebrations in Smoke#106.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#107.src: I suspect that flame was set by a changeling, hoping to use the fire as a distraction to infiltrate the festival. To catch someone off guard and take their form.
Celebrations in Smoke#107.dst: あの火はチェンジリングの仕業でしょう。騒ぎに乗じて祭りに潜り込み、油断した者の姿を奪うつもりだった。
Celebrations in Smoke#107.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#108.src: Due to your efforts, they were unable to do so. But they could not have gone far.
Celebrations in Smoke#108.dst: あなたのおかげで失敗しましたが、遠くへは行けないはず。
Celebrations in Smoke#108.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#109.src: I rounded up the three people nearest to where the fire ignited and found all of them had snuck in without a medallion!
Celebrations in Smoke#109.dst: 火元の近くにいた三人を集めたところ、全員メダリオンなしで忍び込んでいました！
Celebrations in Smoke#109.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#110.src: While I keep them held here... I'd ask of you to interrogate them and, if needed, search around the festival to find information on who they really are.
Celebrations in Smoke#110.dst: 彼らはここに留めておきます…尋問し、必要なら祭りを調べて、正体を突き止めてください。
Celebrations in Smoke#110.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#111.src: Once you have unmasked each of them for who they really are, return to me and tell me which one is a changeling in disguise. I can handle matters from there.
Celebrations in Smoke#111.dst: 全員の正体を暴いたら戻って、誰が化けたチェンジリングかを教えてください。後は私が対処します。
Celebrations in Smoke#111.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#112.src: Take this book. You can write any notes you take while investigating down to check later.
Celebrations in Smoke#112.dst: この本を。調査中のメモを書き留めて、後で見返せます。
Celebrations in Smoke#112.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#113.src: Once you've investigated all of them, you can return to me.
Celebrations in Smoke#113.dst: 全員を調べ終えたら、私のところへ戻ってください。
Celebrations in Smoke#113.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#114.src: Find evidence against the three suspects.
Celebrations in Smoke#114.dst: 三人の容疑者の証拠を見つける。

Celebrations in Smoke#115.src: Come back to me once you've found what they're all hiding.
Celebrations in Smoke#115.dst: 皆が隠していることを突き止めたら、戻ってきてください。
Celebrations in Smoke#115.speaker: Festival Organizer

Celebrations in Smoke#116.src: I hope you're enjoying the festival!
Celebrations in Smoke#116.dst: 祭りを楽しんでくれているといいが！
Celebrations in Smoke#116.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#118.dst: おお！本当にありがとう。
Celebrations in Smoke#118.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#119.src: I don't know how, but this alley must have slipped through our planning.
Celebrations in Smoke#119.dst: なぜか、この路地が警備計画から漏れていたらしい。
Celebrations in Smoke#119.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#120.src: I'll stand here for now to make sure no one can get in.
Celebrations in Smoke#120.dst: しばらくここに立って、誰も入れないようにする。
Celebrations in Smoke#120.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#121.src: I'm so grateful you warned us before anyone bad might have noticed it.
Celebrations in Smoke#121.dst: 悪い奴に気づかれる前に知らせてくれて、本当に助かった。
Celebrations in Smoke#121.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#122.src: Thank you so much for exposing that gap in our security!
Celebrations in Smoke#122.dst: 警備の穴を見つけてくれて、本当にありがとう！
Celebrations in Smoke#122.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#123.src: I'm um Arris. I don't know what's happening, I got shoved into here by the festival organizer with these other two.

Celebrations in Smoke#124.src: I'm simply an ordinary member of the Kalkalrah clan, I don't know what's happening.
Celebrations in Smoke#124.dst: 僕は Kalkalrah 氏族のただの一員で、何が起きてるのか分からないんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#124.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#125.src: Please don't accuse me of doing whatever you think I did, please.
Celebrations in Smoke#125.dst: 僕が何かしたって決めつけないで、お願いだから。
Celebrations in Smoke#125.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#126.src: Nothing, I don't think. Or, well, that's not what I meant.
Celebrations in Smoke#126.dst: 何も、だと思う。いや、そういう意味じゃなくて。
Celebrations in Smoke#126.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#127.src: I only, um, do general upkeep. Fixing stuff and cleaning stuff, I mean.
Celebrations in Smoke#127.dst: 僕は、その、雑用係なんだ。修理とか掃除とか。
Celebrations in Smoke#127.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#128.src: There's not much more to say than that, you know?
Celebrations in Smoke#128.dst: それ以上言うことはあんまりないよ、ね？
Celebrations in Smoke#128.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#129.src: I'm nothing more than a helpful member of my clan who assists in the, uh- in the "making everyone live together with ease" part of clan life!
Celebrations in Smoke#129.dst: 僕は氏族の役に立つ一員で、ええと、氏族生活の「みんなが楽に暮らせるようにする」部分を手伝ってるだけ！
Celebrations in Smoke#129.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#130.src: That's what I mean by nothing, you see, that's what I meant when I said that.
Celebrations in Smoke#130.dst: 「何も」ってそういう意味。さっき言ったのはそういうこと。
Celebrations in Smoke#130.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#131.src: I don't literally do nothing, obviously, that would be dumb. I have an important role and am, uh, valued by my clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#131.dst: もちろん本当に何もしないわけじゃない、それじゃバカだ。大事な役目があって、その、氏族に大切にされてる。
Celebrations in Smoke#131.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#132.src: But it isn't super important or cool or anything, that's what I meant by nothing.
Celebrations in Smoke#132.dst: でもすごく重要とかカッコいいとかじゃない。「何も」はそういう意味。
Celebrations in Smoke#132.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#133.src: Oh, that's what you meant. You, um, wanted a specific answer.
Celebrations in Smoke#133.dst: あ、そういう意味か。具体的な答えが、その、欲しかったんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#133.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#134.src: Okay. I can give you that.
Celebrations in Smoke#134.dst: わかった。それなら言える。
Celebrations in Smoke#134.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#135.src: Like sometimes I will guard things. I will, um, um, stand watch for changelings or thieves or animals!
Celebrations in Smoke#135.dst: 例えば見張りをすることもある。その、ええと、チェンジリングや泥棒や動物を見張るんだ！
Celebrations in Smoke#135.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#136.src: Or anything trying to steal. We try to stop people from stealing from us.
Celebrations in Smoke#136.dst: 盗もうとする奴も。盗みを防ごうとしてるんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#136.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#138.src: Oh, sorry, I'm not trying to be.
Celebrations in Smoke#138.dst: あ、ごめん、そんなつもりじゃ。
Celebrations in Smoke#138.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#139.src: I'm not, um, sure what's happening. And that makes me a little nervous, can you understand?
Celebrations in Smoke#139.dst: 何が起きてるのか、その、よく分からなくて。それで少し緊張してるんだ、分かる？
Celebrations in Smoke#139.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#140.src: All this investigation stuff makes me feel like I did something wrong. And I didn't do anything wrong!
Celebrations in Smoke#140.dst: こういう調べられ方をすると、悪いことをした気になる。何もしてないのに！
Celebrations in Smoke#140.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#141.src: But it's hard to prove that and so I get nervous and stumble over the things I'm saying and misstate what I really mean which only makes it harder!
Celebrations in Smoke#141.dst: でもそれを証明するのは難しくて、緊張して、言葉につまって、言いたいことを言い間違えて、余計に難しくなる！
Celebrations in Smoke#141.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#142.src: Sorry. I don't think I'm helping my case.
Celebrations in Smoke#142.dst: ごめん。弁解になってないよね。
Celebrations in Smoke#142.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#143.dst: ええと、分からない。ごめん。
Celebrations in Smoke#143.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#144.src: I think a little bit? But obviously not as much as this! Like when I'm under interrogation for something I didn't do even though you really seem to think I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#144.dst: 少しは、かな？でもこんなにひどくはない！やってもいないことで尋問されて、しかも本気で疑われてる時ほどは。
Celebrations in Smoke#144.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#145.src: Well, um, of course you do. You're going to think I committed arson or something and then report me and everything will be horrible.
Celebrations in Smoke#145.dst: そ、そりゃそう思うよね。僕が放火か何かしたと思って、報告して、全部最悪になるんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#145.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#146.src: There's no way you don't think I didn't. Look at how much time you're spending interrogating me compared to everyone else.
Celebrations in Smoke#146.dst: そう思ってないはずがない。他の人に比べて、僕の尋問にどれだけ時間をかけてるか見てよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#146.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#147.src: Please. Please don't. I didn't do it I promise I didn't do it, please don't think that I did it.
Celebrations in Smoke#147.dst: お願い。お願いだから。僕はやってない、本当にやってない、やったなんて思わないで。
Celebrations in Smoke#147.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#148.src: I'm innocent I promise please, I didn't do anything I didn't I swear.
Celebrations in Smoke#148.dst: 僕は無実だよ本当にお願い、何もしてない誓って。
Celebrations in Smoke#148.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#149.dst: ええと、じゃあ、やってみる。
Celebrations in Smoke#149.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#155.src: Sorry I don't think I'm, uh, cut out for that, sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#155.dst: ごめん、僕、その、こういうの向いてないみたい。ごめん。
Celebrations in Smoke#155.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#157.src: No, I don't think- I didn't see.
Celebrations in Smoke#157.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#158.src: Maybe I saw some movement out of the corner of my eye? But that could have been nothing.
Celebrations in Smoke#158.dst: 目の端で何か動いたかも？でも気のせいかもしれない。
Celebrations in Smoke#158.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#159.src: It's hard to know, I wasn't really paying attention at the time and now you're asking me these questions like I have some sort of, um, picture perfect memory!
Celebrations in Smoke#159.dst: 分からないよ、あの時ちゃんと見てなかったし、なのにそんな質問をされても、その、完璧な記憶があるわけじゃないんだ！
Celebrations in Smoke#159.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#160.src: Even though I definitely don't! And wasn't even trying to remember what was happening in the first place!
Celebrations in Smoke#160.dst: そんなの絶対にない！そもそも覚えておこうとすらしてなかったんだ！
Celebrations in Smoke#160.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#161.src: Sorry, I was shouting, wasn't I. I didn't mean to. I'm only stressed. Sorry.
Celebrations in Smoke#161.dst: ごめん、怒鳴ってたよね。わざとじゃない。追い詰められてるだけ。ごめん。
Celebrations in Smoke#161.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#162.src: I didn't! I promise I didn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#162.dst: してない！本当にしてない。
Celebrations in Smoke#162.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#163.src: Please don't think I tried to, I promise I have no idea what you're talking about.
Celebrations in Smoke#163.dst: やろうとしたなんて思わないで、何の話か本当に分からない。
Celebrations in Smoke#163.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#164.src: All that I was doing was sitting there quietly and then all of a sudden behind me there were really big flames and then before I could even act you threw water on them and saved the wickerman and then I was being brought in here even though I
Celebrations in Smoke#164.dst: 静かに座ってただけなのに、急に後ろで大きな火が上がって、動く前に君が水をかけてウィッカーマンを救って、それで僕はここに連れてこられたんだ、僕は
Celebrations in Smoke#164.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#165.src: didn't do anything and am just an ordinary clan member and have nothing to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#165.dst: 何もしてないし、ただの普通の氏族の一員だし、隠すことなんて何もないのに。
Celebrations in Smoke#165.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#166.src: I promise I didn't try to burn down the wickerman.
Celebrations in Smoke#166.dst: ウィッカーマンを燃やそうとなんてしてない、本当だよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#166.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#167.src: Find someone who might know something about Arris's clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#167.dst: Arris の氏族について知っていそうな人を探す。

Celebrations in Smoke#168.src: I love being a part of the Kalkalrah clan, but at times like this it's nice to have the chance to be alone.
Celebrations in Smoke#168.dst: Kalkalrah 氏族の一員でいるのは好きだけど、こういう時は一人になれるのもいい。
Celebrations in Smoke#168.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#169.src: Staring across the pond, enjoying the festival, surrounded by people I love.
Celebrations in Smoke#169.dst: 池の向こうを眺め、祭りを楽しみ、愛する人たちに囲まれて。
Celebrations in Smoke#169.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#170.src: It's a sort of quiet, safe calm. One unlike the rest of the year.
Celebrations in Smoke#170.dst: 静かで、安全な穏やかさ。一年の他の時とは違う。
Celebrations in Smoke#170.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#171.src: Hmm? Ah. Yes, unfortunately I do.
Celebrations in Smoke#171.dst: ん？ああ。残念ながら知っています。
Celebrations in Smoke#171.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#172.src: They were a member of our clan until a week ago, when they were expelled and exiled.
Celebrations in Smoke#172.dst: 一週間前までは私たちの氏族の一員でした。追放されたのです。
Celebrations in Smoke#172.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#173.src: Their old medallion was handed to me to burn. In fact, just on my way into the festival I threw its ashes up the tallest tree in {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#173.dst: 古いメダリオンは私が焼くことに。祭りに来る途中で、その灰を {p} で一番高い木の上に撒いたところです。
Celebrations in Smoke#173.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#174.src: Interrogated them? Oh, I hope they haven't done anything bad.
Celebrations in Smoke#174.dst: 尋問？ああ、悪いことをしていなければいいのですが。
Celebrations in Smoke#174.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#175.src: You know, they were always a bit troubled. But I don't think they're bad. They just weren't suited for clan life.
Celebrations in Smoke#175.dst: 昔から少し問題を抱えていました。でも悪い人ではない。氏族の暮らしに合わなかっただけです。
Celebrations in Smoke#175.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#177.src: The fate they were given will be a hard one though. Most exiles don't survive a year.
Celebrations in Smoke#177.dst: でも、下された運命は過酷です。追放者の多くは一年ともちません。
Celebrations in Smoke#177.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#178.src: Not as much as I wish you could. Please treat them with kindness though, they only lie out of fear.
Celebrations in Smoke#178.dst: お役に立てず残念です。でもどうか優しく。怖くて嘘をつくだけですから。
Celebrations in Smoke#178.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#179.src: I do not mean to be rude, but you cut an imposing figure. There's a lot to be afraid of.
Celebrations in Smoke#179.dst: 失礼ですが、あなたは威圧感がある。怖いことだらけなのですよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#179.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#180.src: I hope they stays well, even if they are troubled.
Celebrations in Smoke#180.dst: 問題を抱えていても、無事でいてほしいものです。
Celebrations in Smoke#180.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#181.src: No no no, that isn't true at all.
Celebrations in Smoke#181.dst: 違う違う、全然そんなことない。
Celebrations in Smoke#181.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#182.src: I have no idea who or what you were talking to but I can assure you I, uh, was not exiled from my clan very recently.
Celebrations in Smoke#182.dst: 誰と話したのか知らないけど、断言する、僕は、その、最近氏族を追放されたりしてない。
Celebrations in Smoke#182.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#183.src: You don't have any proof of it, right? Right? So it's my word against theirs, there is no reason to believe anything that they have to say over me.
Celebrations in Smoke#183.dst: 証拠はないよね？ね？なら僕の言葉と向こうの言葉だ。僕より向こうを信じる理由なんてない。
Celebrations in Smoke#183.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#184.src: I'm an, um, ordinary clan member who got caught up in something that I do not understand.
Celebrations in Smoke#184.dst: 僕は、その、よく分からないことに巻き込まれた普通の氏族の一員だよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#184.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#185.src: Search the tallest tree in {p} for Arris's burnt medallion.
Celebrations in Smoke#185.dst: {p} で一番高い木を調べ、焼けた Arris のメダリオンを探す。

Celebrations in Smoke#188.src: Yes I was exiled from my clan and yes I did lie to you but I promise I didn't do anything else bad.
Celebrations in Smoke#188.dst: そうだよ追放されたし嘘もついた、でも他に悪いことは何もしてない、本当に。
Celebrations in Smoke#188.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#189.src: I don't know who burned down the wickerman but it wasn't me, you have to believe me.
Celebrations in Smoke#189.dst: 誰がウィッカーマンを燃やしたかは知らないけど僕じゃない、信じてよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#189.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#190.src: I only lied because I panicked and I'm sorry for panicking but please please please you cannot tell them that I'm a changeling or whatever.
Celebrations in Smoke#190.dst: 嘘をついたのはパニックになったからで、それはごめん、でもお願いお願いお願い、僕がチェンジリングだなんて言わないで。
Celebrations in Smoke#190.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#192.src: Because they all thought I stole something! Even though I promise, I promise I didn't.
Celebrations in Smoke#192.dst: みんな僕が何か盗んだと思ったんだ！誓って、誓って盗んでないのに。
Celebrations in Smoke#192.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#193.src: I was supposed to be keeping watch over our clan's stores. And I don't know how, but a box of our special green tea went missing.
Celebrations in Smoke#193.dst: 僕は氏族の倉庫の見張り番だった。なのに、どうしてか特製の緑茶が一箱なくなったんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#193.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#194.src: I promise I didn't steal it, I really do. But none of them believed me, it somehow disappeared.
Celebrations in Smoke#194.dst: 本当に盗んでない、本当だよ。でも誰も信じてくれなかった。なぜか消えたんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#194.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#195.src: They said I had lost years of trust with them, over something I swear I didn't do, and kicked me out.
Celebrations in Smoke#195.dst: やってもいないことで、長年の信頼を失ったと言われて、追い出された。
Celebrations in Smoke#195.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#196.src: Since then, I've been having to find my own way to survive. I've, uh, not been very good at that.
Celebrations in Smoke#196.dst: それ以来、自力で生きるしかなかった。その、あまりうまくいってない。
Celebrations in Smoke#196.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#197.src: Maybe a week? I- I- I'm not exactly sure. It has been difficult keeping track of time.
Celebrations in Smoke#197.dst: 一週間くらい？わ、わ、分からない。日にちを数えるのも大変で。
Celebrations in Smoke#197.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#198.src: Yes! I've never lost anything like that before and I definitely haven't stolen anything ever at all.
Celebrations in Smoke#198.dst: うん！あんな物をなくしたのは初めてだし、盗みなんて一度もしたことない。
Celebrations in Smoke#198.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#199.src: ... Although, I was caught sleeping while on watch a few times. And my clan got really upset with me for that, even though I promise nothing bad happened.
Celebrations in Smoke#199.dst: …でも、見張り中に寝てるのを何度か見つかった。何も起きなかったのに、氏族にすごく怒られた。
Celebrations in Smoke#199.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#200.src: I wasn't trying to sleep, but it's so hard to stay up all night while nothing is happening.
Celebrations in Smoke#200.dst: 寝るつもりはなかった。でも何も起きない夜にずっと起きてるのは本当に辛いんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#200.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#202.src: Oh, uh, well you know. I was, um.
Celebrations in Smoke#202.dst: あ、ええと、その。僕は、その。
Celebrations in Smoke#202.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#203.dst: 食べ物が尽きかけてて。
Celebrations in Smoke#203.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#204.src: And this was the only place I could think of that would have any and I really missed not having to run across the {p} trying to forage and I really really hate being exiled and I need somewhere to go.
Celebrations in Smoke#204.dst: 食べ物がありそうな場所はここしか思いつかなくて、{p} を走り回って食べ物を探さなくていい日々が恋しくて、追放なんて本当に本当に嫌で、行く場所が欲しかったんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#204.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#205.src: Sorry, I didn't mean to dump all my troubles on you.
Celebrations in Smoke#205.dst: ごめん、悩みを全部ぶちまけるつもりじゃなかった。
Celebrations in Smoke#205.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#207.src: Um. If it wouldn't be too much to ask.
Celebrations in Smoke#207.dst: ええと。もし迷惑じゃなければ。
Celebrations in Smoke#207.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#208.src: Would you mind getting me a Fortune Cookie?
Celebrations in Smoke#208.dst: フォーチュンクッキーを取ってきてくれないかな？
Celebrations in Smoke#208.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#209.src: I don't want to burden you or anything and I know I just lied to you and you're trying to investigate me for a horrible crime, but I'm really hungry and didn't get a chance to eat before you all shoved me in here.
Celebrations in Smoke#209.dst: 迷惑はかけたくないし、さっき嘘をついたし、君がひどい罪で僕を調べてるのも分かってる。でも本当にお腹が空いてて、押し込まれる前に何も食べられなかったんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#209.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#210.src: Thank you so so so so much.
Celebrations in Smoke#210.dst: ほんとにほんとにありがとう。
Celebrations in Smoke#210.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#211.src: Thank you! I don't think I've had one of these since I was a kid.
Celebrations in Smoke#211.dst: ありがとう！子どもの頃以来、食べてないと思う。
Celebrations in Smoke#211.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#212.src: Here, let me read my fortune to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#212.dst: ほら、占いを読んであげる。
Celebrations in Smoke#212.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#213.src: "Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem."
Celebrations in Smoke#213.dst: 「身近な者に用心せよ！見かけどおりとは限らない。」
Celebrations in Smoke#213.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#214.src: That, uh, would have been more useful a couple weeks ago.
Celebrations in Smoke#214.dst: それ、その、二週間前に欲しかったな。
Celebrations in Smoke#214.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#216.src: Sorry. Please don't think I did whatever I can tell you think I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#216.dst: ごめん。君が思ってるようなことを僕がしたと思わないで。
Celebrations in Smoke#216.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#217.src: Thank you! I don't think I've had one of these since I was a kid.
Celebrations in Smoke#217.dst: ありがとう！子どもの頃以来、食べてないと思う。
Celebrations in Smoke#217.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#218.src: Here, let me read my fortune to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#218.dst: ほら、占いを読んであげる。
Celebrations in Smoke#218.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#219.src: "Beware some of those closest to you! They may not be what they seem."
Celebrations in Smoke#219.dst: 「身近な者に用心せよ！見かけどおりとは限らない。」
Celebrations in Smoke#219.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#220.src: That, uh, would have been more useful a couple weeks ago.
Celebrations in Smoke#220.dst: それ、その、二週間前に欲しかったな。
Celebrations in Smoke#220.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#221.src: Burick. I'm simply a humble green tea trader.
Celebrations in Smoke#221.dst: Burick だ。ただのしがない緑茶商人だ。

Celebrations in Smoke#222.src: I don't know what happened, I wasn't involved, and that's all I have to say.
Celebrations in Smoke#222.dst: 何が起きたか知らないし、関わってもいない。言うことはそれだけだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#222.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#223.dst: 言うまでもないと思ったが。
Celebrations in Smoke#223.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#224.src: One clan wants to get rid of stuff, while another clan wants to get their hands on it.
Celebrations in Smoke#224.dst: ある氏族は物を手放したい、別の氏族はそれを欲しがる。
Celebrations in Smoke#224.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#225.src: The {p} is a big and dangerous place. They need a trader to make it happen.
Celebrations in Smoke#225.dst: {p} は広くて危険だ。取り持つ商人が要る。
Celebrations in Smoke#225.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#226.src: Yes. Someone has to do it though.
Celebrations in Smoke#226.dst: ああ。だが誰かがやらないとな。
Celebrations in Smoke#226.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#227.src: Nope. And neither has anyone else I've spoken to.
Celebrations in Smoke#227.dst: いや。俺が話した他の誰もな。
Celebrations in Smoke#227.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#228.src: I'm not even certain they're real.
Celebrations in Smoke#228.dst: 実在するのかも怪しいと思ってる。
Celebrations in Smoke#228.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#230.src: Don't mention to anyone else that I said that.
Celebrations in Smoke#230.dst: 俺がそう言ったことは誰にも言うな。
Celebrations in Smoke#230.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#231.src: Some people get really upset when you imply that.
Celebrations in Smoke#231.dst: それをほのめかすと、ひどく怒る奴もいる。
Celebrations in Smoke#231.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#232.src: The Kalkalrah clan sells it to me. So wherever they get it, I suppose.
Celebrations in Smoke#232.dst: Kalkalrah 氏族から買ってる。仕入れ先は、そいつらの仕入れ先だろう。
Celebrations in Smoke#232.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#233.src: Yes. That's what a merchant is.
Celebrations in Smoke#233.dst: ああ。商人とはそういうものだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#233.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#234.src: I'm not a member of any clan. I travel around selling my products.
Celebrations in Smoke#234.dst: どの氏族にも属していない。旅をしながら品を売っている。
Celebrations in Smoke#234.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#235.src: Clan life would be too stifling. I like getting to see more than the trunk of a single tree.
Celebrations in Smoke#235.dst: 氏族の暮らしは息が詰まる。一本の木の幹以外も見ていたいんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#235.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#238.src: I'm a merchant, not a member of a clan.
Celebrations in Smoke#238.dst: 俺は商人で、氏族の者じゃない。
Celebrations in Smoke#238.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#239.src: I don't have a way to get one and it hasn't been a problem.
Celebrations in Smoke#239.dst: 手に入れる手段がないし、今まで困ったこともない。
Celebrations in Smoke#239.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#240.src: I walked closely behind a group that did.
Celebrations in Smoke#240.dst: 持ってる集団のすぐ後ろを歩いた。
Celebrations in Smoke#240.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#242.src: Gives me a good chance to investigate the green tea market too.
Celebrations in Smoke#242.dst: 緑茶の市場を探るいい機会でもある。
Celebrations in Smoke#242.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#243.dst: あまり信用されてなかった。
Celebrations in Smoke#243.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#244.src: Trades were handled quickly, while the other parties were heavily armed, and in small enough quantities that if I was a changeling no major loss would be incurred.
Celebrations in Smoke#244.dst: 取引は手早く、相手は重武装。量も少なく、俺がチェンジリングでも大した損にならない程度だった。
Celebrations in Smoke#244.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#246.src: I did not and I would not hazard a guess as to who did.
Celebrations in Smoke#246.dst: やってないし、誰がやったかを推測する気もない。
Celebrations in Smoke#246.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#247.src: I am answering your questions to the best of my knowledge and ability.
Celebrations in Smoke#247.dst: 知る限り、できる限りで質問には答えている。
Celebrations in Smoke#247.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#248.src: Isn't it your job to figure that stuff out?
Celebrations in Smoke#248.dst: それを突き止めるのがあんたの仕事だろう？
Celebrations in Smoke#248.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#249.src: I see no reason to do your own work and give you more rope to hang me with.
Celebrations in Smoke#249.dst: あんたの仕事を代わりにして、俺を吊るす縄を増やしてやる理由はない。
Celebrations in Smoke#249.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#251.src: I'm cooperating. But I don't see why I should trust someone I don't know or trust with more details than they need.
Celebrations in Smoke#251.dst: 協力はしている。だが知らない相手に、必要以上のことを話す理由はない。
Celebrations in Smoke#251.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#252.src: It would be helpful for my business if you just let me go.
Celebrations in Smoke#252.dst: さっさと解放してくれれば、商売には助かるんだがな。
Celebrations in Smoke#252.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#253.src: But I'm not demanding that. You can give me the same etiquette.
Celebrations in Smoke#253.dst: だが要求はしていない。あんたも同じ礼儀で頼む。
Celebrations in Smoke#253.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#255.src: Sure, but I have no use for your emeralds.
Celebrations in Smoke#255.dst: いいが、あんたのエメラルドは要らない。
Celebrations in Smoke#255.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#256.src: It's been a while since I've had some rabbit roast. Get some of that for me and I'll see what I can do.
Celebrations in Smoke#256.dst: ウサギのローストはしばらく食べてない。買ってきてくれたら、考えてやる。
Celebrations in Smoke#256.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#257.src: Huh. I didn't think you actually would, thanks.
Celebrations in Smoke#257.dst: ほう。本当に買ってくるとは。ありがとう。
Celebrations in Smoke#257.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#258.src: Anyway, I'm terse because I'm used to being. It doesn't really have anything to do with you.
Celebrations in Smoke#258.dst: ともかく、口数が少ないのは慣れのせいだ。あんたのせいじゃない。
Celebrations in Smoke#258.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#259.src: I spend so much time alone by myself in the woods that I'm not used to making conversation, even when it's needed.
Celebrations in Smoke#259.dst: 森で一人の時間が長すぎて、必要な時でも会話に慣れていないんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#259.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#260.src: Sorry, you seem nice, I wish I could be of more use to your investigation.
Celebrations in Smoke#260.dst: すまない。あんたはいい奴そうだ、もっと調査の役に立てればいいんだが。
Celebrations in Smoke#260.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#261.src: I have enough of them as is.
Celebrations in Smoke#261.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#262.src: Most of the time I trade in kind anyway.
Celebrations in Smoke#262.dst: どうせ大抵は物々交換だ。
Celebrations in Smoke#262.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#266.src: I don't know and you're not getting a guess out of me.
Celebrations in Smoke#266.dst: 知らないし、推測を引き出そうとしても無駄だ。
Celebrations in Smoke#266.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#267.src: I could have missed something, but I didn't see any of us do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#267.dst: 見落としたかもしれないが、俺たちの誰かがやるのは見てない。
Celebrations in Smoke#267.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#268.src: Find someone who might be familiar with a green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#268.dst: 緑茶商人を知っていそうな人を探す。

Celebrations in Smoke#269.src: It's the festival again! And you know what that means...
Celebrations in Smoke#269.dst: また祭りだ！つまり、分かるよな…
Celebrations in Smoke#269.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#270.src: Green tea!!! I never know how to get this stuff outside the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#270.dst: 緑茶！！！祭り以外でどこで手に入るのか、さっぱりだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#270.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#271.src: I'm going to spend all night standing right here, drinking as much of it as I can!
Celebrations in Smoke#271.dst: 今夜は一晩中ここに立って、飲めるだけ飲むぞ！
Celebrations in Smoke#271.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#273.src: Please, tell me, I would love to know. I've been searching for one for years.
Celebrations in Smoke#273.dst: 頼む、教えてくれ。ぜひ知りたい。何年も探してるんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#273.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#274.src: The closest I got was some odd tent in the woods east of {p} with a box of the stuff, but that just a scavenger's tent.
Celebrations in Smoke#274.dst: 一番近づけたのは、{p} の東の森にある妙なテントで、緑茶が一箱あった。でもただの拾い屋のテントだった。
Celebrations in Smoke#274.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#275.src: I wish the Kalkalrah clan wouldn't keep the secret so well hidden.
Celebrations in Smoke#275.dst: Kalkalrah 氏族があんなに秘密を隠さなきゃいいのに。
Celebrations in Smoke#275.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#276.src: No, of course not. They keep it a secret, hoarding it up all year, so they can charge us extra during the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#276.dst: いや、まさか。秘密にして一年中ため込み、祭りで高く売りつけるんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#276.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#277.src: They do all this under the guise of it being "mystical" and "only suited for ceremonial occasions like this," but everyone sees through their sales techniques.
Celebrations in Smoke#277.dst: 「神秘的」だの「こうした儀式の場にしか合わない」だのと言ってるが、商売の手口なんてみんなお見通しだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#277.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#278.src: ... not that it stops me from buying every bottle I can get my hands on. It feels amazing.
Celebrations in Smoke#278.dst: …まあ、それでも手に入る瓶は全部買っちまうんだけど。最高なんだよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#278.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#279.src: Okay, you have to be holding out on me.
Celebrations in Smoke#279.dst: おい、何か隠してるだろ。
Celebrations in Smoke#279.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#280.src: Come on, give me the name. What do you want, emeralds? Information? I'll give it to you, just tell me where I can find a year round green tea merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#280.dst: なあ、名前を教えてくれ。何が欲しい、エメラルド？情報？何でもやるから、一年中いる緑茶商人の居場所を教えてくれ。
Celebrations in Smoke#280.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#281.src: What are you wasting my time for then?
Celebrations in Smoke#281.dst: じゃあ何で俺の時間を無駄にした？
Celebrations in Smoke#281.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#282.src: If you get any leads on that tea trader, make sure to let me know right away.
Celebrations in Smoke#282.dst: その茶商人の手がかりがあったら、すぐ教えてくれよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#282.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#283.src: You must not have spoken to the people I sold to then.
Celebrations in Smoke#283.dst: なら、俺が売った相手とは話してないんだろう。
Celebrations in Smoke#283.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#284.src: Not sure how much of an enthusiast they could be if they don't know me.
Celebrations in Smoke#284.dst: 俺を知らないなら、大した愛好家でもないんだろう。
Celebrations in Smoke#284.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#285.src: Even so, that's only the words of one person. I won't pretend to know everyone in the {p}. Even the ones I do meet I don't make a major impression on.
Celebrations in Smoke#285.dst: それに、一人の言い分に過ぎない。{p} の全員を知ってるふりはしない。会った相手にも、大して印象は残らない。
Celebrations in Smoke#285.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#287.src: Search for a camp east of {p} [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] that Burick might have been spotted at.
Celebrations in Smoke#287.dst: Burick が目撃されたかもしれない {p} 東の野営地 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] を探す。

Celebrations in Smoke#289.src: What else would I need? I'm sure while you were violating my privacy you snooped through my stuff. I have nothing to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#289.dst: 他に何が要る？俺のプライバシーを侵す間に、持ち物も漁ったんだろう。隠すことはない。
Celebrations in Smoke#289.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#290.src: There simply isn't much excess gear that I need as a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#290.dst: 商人に余計な装備はそう要らないんだよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#290.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#293.src: You're not believing that, are you.
Celebrations in Smoke#293.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#294.src: Fine. I'm not really a merchant.
Celebrations in Smoke#294.dst: わかった。本当は商人じゃない。
Celebrations in Smoke#294.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#295.src: I'm a scavenger. I was born without a clan and have lived my entire life without one.
Celebrations in Smoke#295.dst: 俺は拾い屋だ。氏族を持たずに生まれ、ずっと氏族なしで生きてきた。
Celebrations in Smoke#295.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#296.src: When pressed, I pose as a merchant. I've spent enough time wandering the {p} that I have enough knowledge to be one.
Celebrations in Smoke#296.dst: 問い詰められると商人のふりをする。{p} を長くさまよって、それだけの知識はある。
Celebrations in Smoke#296.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#297.src: Still though, that's all. I won't pretend I didn't lie to you, but beside that I'm telling the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#297.dst: だが、それだけだ。嘘をついたことは認める。それ以外は本当だ。
Celebrations in Smoke#297.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#298.src: I don't know who tried to burn down the wickerman or why. It certainly wasn't me.
Celebrations in Smoke#298.dst: 誰がなぜウィッカーマンを燃やそうとしたかは知らない。俺じゃないのは確かだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#298.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#299.src: There's not much to do out in the wilderness. Only so many times I can forage the same bush for food or admire the same river.
Celebrations in Smoke#299.dst: 荒野ではやることがない。同じ茂みで食べ物を探すのも、同じ川を眺めるのも、限度がある。
Celebrations in Smoke#299.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#300.src: I get lonely. I still am lonely.
Celebrations in Smoke#300.dst: 寂しくなる。今も寂しい。
Celebrations in Smoke#300.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#301.src: The festival is the only time of year I really get to be with others, I've been attending for years now.
Celebrations in Smoke#301.dst: 祭りは一年で唯一、誰かと一緒にいられる時だ。もう何年も来ている。
Celebrations in Smoke#301.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#302.src: Not that I can speak to anyone much. They might realize I'm not supposed to be here.
Celebrations in Smoke#302.dst: とはいえ、あまり人と話せない。ここにいるべきじゃないと気づかれるかもしれない。
Celebrations in Smoke#302.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#303.src: How did you actually get in?
Celebrations in Smoke#303.dst: 実際はどうやって入った？
Celebrations in Smoke#303.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#304.src: I've managed to find a spot in the {p} wall where you can leap over and the guards can't see. I'm amazed they haven't fixed it yet.
Celebrations in Smoke#304.dst: {p} の塀に、飛び越えられて衛兵から見えない場所を見つけた。まだ直してないのには驚きだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#304.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#305.src: Come to think of it, if someone else was coming here uninvited, that's probably how they got in too.
Celebrations in Smoke#305.dst: そういえば、他にも招かれてない奴がいたなら、たぶん同じ所から入ったんだろう。
Celebrations in Smoke#305.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#306.src: I found it lying on the ground a few weeks ago, cracked open and half empty.
Celebrations in Smoke#306.dst: 数週間前に地面に落ちてた。割れて、半分空だった。
Celebrations in Smoke#306.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#307.src: Someone must have lost it or something, maybe a patrol of soldiers? That would be odd though, they're usually quite tidy.
Celebrations in Smoke#307.dst: 誰かが落としたんだろう、巡回の兵士か？だが妙だ、あいつらは普段きちんとしてる。
Celebrations in Smoke#307.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#308.src: It could have been one of the clans too. At least one of them knows how to produce the stuff.
Celebrations in Smoke#308.dst: 氏族のどれかかもしれない。少なくとも一つは作り方を知ってる。
Celebrations in Smoke#308.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#309.src: I don't know, but I'm glad I found it! It's been too long since I've managed to drink any.
Celebrations in Smoke#309.dst: さあな、でも見つけてよかった！飲めたのは久しぶりだったんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#309.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#310.src: I hope you didn't confiscate it while you were snooping through my home.
Celebrations in Smoke#310.dst: 俺の家を漁った時、没収してないといいが。
Celebrations in Smoke#310.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#311.src: My parents were exiled, I think?
Celebrations in Smoke#311.dst: 親が追放されたんだと思う。
Celebrations in Smoke#311.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#312.src: I've never really gotten the entirety of that story, so I'm unsure.
Celebrations in Smoke#312.dst: その話は全部聞いたことがないから、よく分からない。
Celebrations in Smoke#312.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#313.src: I don't really feel like going deeper into it than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#313.dst: それ以上は、あまり話したくない。
Celebrations in Smoke#313.speaker: Burick

Celebrations in Smoke#314.src: It's nice to meet you too. I'm Cerisa, a petty thief.
Celebrations in Smoke#314.dst: こちらこそよろしく。Cerisa、しがない泥棒です。

Celebrations in Smoke#315.src: I snuck into the festival to snag shiny trinkets and whatever else I could get my hands on.
Celebrations in Smoke#315.dst: 光る小物や、手に入る物なら何でもくすねようと、祭りに忍び込みました。
Celebrations in Smoke#315.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#316.src: I was also completely uninvolved in who or what tried to burn down the wickerman, so you can let me go whenever you're ready to.
Celebrations in Smoke#316.dst: ウィッカーマンを燃やそうとした者とは一切無関係なので、準備ができ次第解放してくださって結構です。
Celebrations in Smoke#316.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#317.src: Did you have anything else you wanted to know?
Celebrations in Smoke#317.dst: 他に知りたいことはありますか？
Celebrations in Smoke#317.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#318.src: Because you'd figure it out one way or another, I don't have a more respectable occupation to cover it up with that you wouldn't quickly disprove.
Celebrations in Smoke#318.dst: どのみちあなたは突き止めるでしょうし、すぐに見破られない、まともな職業で隠すこともできませんから。
Celebrations in Smoke#318.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#319.src: It'd be irrational to hide my criminal nature when that is precisely what you're searching for.
Celebrations in Smoke#319.dst: あなたが探しているのがまさにそれなのに、犯罪者の本性を隠すのは合理的ではありません。
Celebrations in Smoke#319.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#320.src: If I deceived you and you found out, you would surely take it as evidence that I had even more to hide.
Celebrations in Smoke#320.dst: もし私が騙し、あなたが見抜けば、さらに隠し事がある証拠と受け取るに違いない。
Celebrations in Smoke#320.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#321.src: My solitary purpose right now is to convince you that I did not try to burn the effigy. I can deal with the consequences of being exposed as a thief later.
Celebrations in Smoke#321.dst: 今の唯一の目的は、私が像を燃やそうとしていないとあなたに納得してもらうこと。泥棒だとばれた報いは後で受けます。
Celebrations in Smoke#321.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#322.src: Of course not, that would be contrary to my overall purpose.
Celebrations in Smoke#322.dst: まさか。それでは私の目的に反します。
Celebrations in Smoke#322.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#323.src: Mind you, I don't expect you to believe me when I say that. You should definitely act as though I am lying to you.
Celebrations in Smoke#323.dst: とはいえ、信じてもらえるとは思っていません。私が嘘をついている前提で動くべきです。
Celebrations in Smoke#323.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#324.src: But I won't. You trusting me is my best ticket out of this mess.
Celebrations in Smoke#324.dst: でも嘘はつきません。あなたの信頼こそ、この窮地から抜ける一番の切符です。
Celebrations in Smoke#324.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#325.src: I do. I have no idea what they'd do to me and I don't want to find out.
Celebrations in Smoke#325.dst: 怖いです。何をされるか分からないし、知りたくもない。
Celebrations in Smoke#325.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#326.src: From what I was able to overhear between you and the organizer, it sounds like you're looking for a changeling.
Celebrations in Smoke#326.dst: 主催者との会話を聞いた限り、あなたはチェンジリングを探しているようですね。
Celebrations in Smoke#326.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#327.src: And based on what they do to just an effigy of a changeling, I have absolutely no desire to find out what would happen to me if they actually thought I was one.
Celebrations in Smoke#327.dst: チェンジリングの像にさえあの仕打ちです。本当にそうだと思われたらどうなるか、知りたくもありません。
Celebrations in Smoke#327.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#328.src: I'll take whatever punishment my thievery gets me and move on.
Celebrations in Smoke#328.dst: 盗みの罰なら甘んじて受けて、先へ進みます。
Celebrations in Smoke#328.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#329.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#329.dst: もちろん、何でもお話しします。
Celebrations in Smoke#329.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#331.src: Of course. I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#331.dst: もちろん。何でもお話しします。
Celebrations in Smoke#331.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#332.src: Yes. Being outside of a clan, there's no one particularly trustworthy in the {p}.
Celebrations in Smoke#332.dst: ええ。氏族の外では、{p} に特に信頼できる人はいません。
Celebrations in Smoke#332.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#333.src: With the changelings, even if I were to find a partner, I don't know how to make medallions and so could never be sure they weren't killed and replaced.
Celebrations in Smoke#333.dst: チェンジリングがいる以上、仲間を得てもメダリオンを作れない私には、殺されて入れ替わっていないと確かめようがない。
Celebrations in Smoke#333.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#334.src: It's much easier this way, I assure you.
Celebrations in Smoke#334.dst: こちらの方がずっと楽です、本当に。
Celebrations in Smoke#334.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#335.src: Whoever I can. For the most part it's the clans, they can be shockingly lazy if you know where you're looking.
Celebrations in Smoke#335.dst: 盗める相手なら誰でも。主に氏族ですね。見る所を知っていれば、驚くほど怠慢です。
Celebrations in Smoke#335.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#336.src: I have stolen a bit from the military when their watch lapses, although that's obviously much harder to pull off.
Celebrations in Smoke#336.dst: 軍の見張りが緩んだ時に少し盗んだこともあります。当然、ずっと難しいですが。
Celebrations in Smoke#336.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#337.src: Not personally, no. I've heard some rumors though.
Celebrations in Smoke#337.dst: 直接はありません。噂は少し聞きましたが。
Celebrations in Smoke#337.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#338.src: Hard to tell fact from fiction, but they certainly seem to be a nasty bunch.
Celebrations in Smoke#338.dst: 真偽は分かりませんが、ずいぶんたちの悪い連中のようです。
Celebrations in Smoke#338.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#339.src: I wouldn't be surprised to hear one tried to break into the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#339.dst: 一体が祭りに忍び込もうとしたと聞いても驚きません。
Celebrations in Smoke#339.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#340.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#340.dst: もちろん、何でもお話しします。
Celebrations in Smoke#340.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#341.src: Not directly, no. But of the three of us, I was the farthest from where the flame was kindled.
Celebrations in Smoke#341.dst: 直接は見ていません。ですが三人の中で、火元から一番遠かったのは私です。
Celebrations in Smoke#341.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#342.src: I may have seen one of the other two suspects move, but I can't be positive about that.
Celebrations in Smoke#342.dst: 他の容疑者の一人が動いたのを見たかもしれません。確かではありませんが。
Celebrations in Smoke#342.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#343.src: If I had more information I would of course provide it.
Celebrations in Smoke#343.dst: もっと情報があれば、もちろんお伝えします。
Celebrations in Smoke#343.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#344.src: Ah, have you decided to try and play confrontational?
Celebrations in Smoke#344.dst: あら、強気に出てみることにしました？
Celebrations in Smoke#344.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#345.src: That's fine, I will reiterate that I didn't do it. Whether you believe me or not, that is the truth.
Celebrations in Smoke#345.dst: 構いません。繰り返しますが、私はやっていません。信じる信じないは別として、それが真実です。
Celebrations in Smoke#345.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#346.src: My fate lies entirely in your hands, so to speak. You don't have to engage in theatrics to intimidate me, you are exactly as scary as you were before.
Celebrations in Smoke#346.dst: 私の運命は、言うなればあなたの手の中。芝居がかった脅しは不要です。あなたは先ほどと同じくらい怖いですから。
Celebrations in Smoke#346.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#347.src: Find someone who might have been observant enough to see Cerisa sneak in.
Celebrations in Smoke#347.dst: Cerisa が忍び込むのを見ていそうな、注意深い人を探す。

Celebrations in Smoke#348.src: Isn't it nice to see kids having fun?
Celebrations in Smoke#348.dst: 子どもが楽しそうだと嬉しいでしょう？
Celebrations in Smoke#348.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#349.src: I try to lighten his life when I can, but it's so hard to some days.
Celebrations in Smoke#349.dst: できる時はあの子の毎日を明るくしたいけど、難しい日もあるの。
Celebrations in Smoke#349.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#350.src: That's why I love the festival. Makes my job easier!
Celebrations in Smoke#350.dst: だから祭りが好き。仕事が楽になるから！
Celebrations in Smoke#350.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#351.src: He can entertain himself, I can watch for danger.
Celebrations in Smoke#351.dst: あの子は勝手に遊べるし、私は危険を見張れる。
Celebrations in Smoke#351.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#352.src: Nothing obviously dangerous, but I always keep in mind.
Celebrations in Smoke#352.dst: 明らかに危ないものはないけど、いつも気にしてるの。
Celebrations in Smoke#352.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#353.src: I did see something very odd a few hours ago though. By the entrance to {p}, it looked like someone hopped over the fence.
Celebrations in Smoke#353.dst: でも数時間前、とても変なものを見たわ。{p} の入口のそばで、誰かが柵を飛び越えたみたいだった。
Celebrations in Smoke#353.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#354.src: It might have been a trick of the light, but I think I saw them change clothes and shove something under the bridge.
Celebrations in Smoke#354.dst: 光の加減かもしれないけど、その人が着替えて、橋の下に何かを押し込むのを見た気がする。
Celebrations in Smoke#354.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#355.src: Those might just be the ramblings of a worried old parent though!
Celebrations in Smoke#355.dst: 心配性の親のうわごとかもしれないけどね！
Celebrations in Smoke#355.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#356.src: Oh really? That's a shame, I thought I was stealthier than that.
Celebrations in Smoke#356.dst: あら、そうですか？残念。もっと隠密に動けていると思っていました。
Celebrations in Smoke#356.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#357.src: I'm not sure that's a real revelation though, I've been open to you that that's what I did.
Celebrations in Smoke#357.dst: でもそれは暴露とは言えませんね。そうしたと最初から打ち明けていますから。
Celebrations in Smoke#357.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#358.src: Is there anything else you wanted to call me to account for?
Celebrations in Smoke#358.dst: 他に、私に責任を問いたいことはありますか？
Celebrations in Smoke#358.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#359.src: Yes, I had a change in clothes. The clothes I wear on a daily basis are no fit for a cheerful atmosphere like the festival.
Celebrations in Smoke#359.dst: ええ、着替えを持っていました。普段の服は、祭りのような陽気な場には合いませんから。
Celebrations in Smoke#359.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#360.src: In that case, I appreciate you keeping me up to date on the progress of your investigation. Your commitment to transparency in the judicial process is admirable.
Celebrations in Smoke#360.dst: では、調査の進捗を逐一教えてくださり感謝します。司法手続きの透明性へのその姿勢、見事なものです。
Celebrations in Smoke#360.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#361.src: Search under the bridge around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for something Cerisa may have left behind.
Celebrations in Smoke#361.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 付近の橋の下で、Cerisa が残した物を探す。

Celebrations in Smoke#363.src: That would be because it's mine.
Celebrations in Smoke#363.dst: それは私の物だからです。
Celebrations in Smoke#363.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#364.src: Your investigation is quite impressive, I'll admit. I was not expecting anyone to find those, I must not have disposed of them properly.
Celebrations in Smoke#364.dst: 見事な調査だと認めましょう。見つかるとは思っていませんでした。処分が甘かったようです。
Celebrations in Smoke#364.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#365.src: Although you did get a bit lucky, didn't you. If no one had spotted me sneak in, you never would have found them.
Celebrations in Smoke#365.dst: でも少し運が良かったのでは？忍び込むのを誰も見ていなければ、見つからなかったはずです。
Celebrations in Smoke#365.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#366.src: I am a deserter from the military, as of a couple days ago. My stop here is a temporary respite to steal whatever I can before disappearing into the {p} as far as I can.
Celebrations in Smoke#366.dst: 私は数日前に軍を脱走しました。ここへ寄ったのは束の間の休息。盗めるだけ盗んで、{p} のできるだけ奥へ消えるつもりです。
Celebrations in Smoke#366.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#367.src: No I didn't. I am a thief who came to the festival in part to steal petty trinkets. Nothing I told you was a lie.
Celebrations in Smoke#367.dst: いいえ。私は小物を盗みに祭りへ来た泥棒です。話したことに嘘は一つもありません。
Celebrations in Smoke#367.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#368.src: I'll grant that I did not tell you things you might have been interested in knowing, but that is only because you never asked about them.
Celebrations in Smoke#368.dst: あなたが知りたがりそうなことを話さなかったのは認めます。ですが、それは聞かれなかったからです。
Celebrations in Smoke#368.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#369.src: Had you asked me if I was a former soldier, I would have provided you with all the information you are being given right now.
Celebrations in Smoke#369.dst: 元兵士かと聞かれていれば、今お話ししている情報をすべてお伝えしていました。
Celebrations in Smoke#369.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#370.src: Yes, it is to a degree. But you have to understand, you trusting me isn't my only strategy to get out of this.
Celebrations in Smoke#370.dst: ええ、ある程度は。ですが信頼を得ることだけが、私の脱出策ではないのです。
Celebrations in Smoke#370.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#371.src: It was a gamble to avoid mentioning my desertion. I had to weigh the odds of you finding evidence of my desertion with the danger I might be in by admitting to it.
Celebrations in Smoke#371.dst: 脱走を伏せたのは賭けでした。証拠を見つけられる確率と、自白した場合の危険とを天秤にかけたのです。
Celebrations in Smoke#371.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#372.src: With hindsight, I bet wrongly, but I don't think my bet was irrational.
Celebrations in Smoke#372.dst: 結果的に賭けは外れましたが、不合理だったとは思いません。
Celebrations in Smoke#372.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#373.src: Had you been a worse investigator or gotten a bit less lucky, it would have paid off immensely.
Celebrations in Smoke#373.dst: あなたがもう少し無能か、運が悪ければ、大当たりだったでしょう。
Celebrations in Smoke#373.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#374.src: And I trust that even now, you are a fair enough judicator you will look at the facts and only the facts.
Celebrations in Smoke#374.dst: そして今でも、あなたは事実だけを見る公正な裁定者だと信じています。
Celebrations in Smoke#374.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#375.src: The facts that show I had nothing to do with what you're investigating.
Celebrations in Smoke#375.dst: 私が調査の件と無関係だと示す事実を。
Celebrations in Smoke#375.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#376.src: You could. And if you did you would be personally and entirely responsible for my death.
Celebrations in Smoke#376.dst: できますね。そうすれば、私の死はすべてあなた個人の責任です。
Celebrations in Smoke#376.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#377.src: Should you choose to, I hope my face haunts your nightmares for the rest of your life.
Celebrations in Smoke#377.dst: もしそうするなら、一生あなたの悪夢に私の顔が出てくればいい。
Celebrations in Smoke#377.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#378.src: But I don't think you will.
Celebrations in Smoke#378.dst: でも、あなたはしないでしょう。
Celebrations in Smoke#378.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#379.src: I'll admit I struggle to express this in words, but you don't seem the type.
Celebrations in Smoke#379.dst: 言葉にしにくいのですが、あなたはそういう人に見えない。
Celebrations in Smoke#379.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#380.src: You couldn't really go through with something like that.
Celebrations in Smoke#380.dst: あなたに、そんなことはやり通せません。
Celebrations in Smoke#380.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#381.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#381.dst: もちろん、何でもお話しします。
Celebrations in Smoke#381.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#382.src: Military life was too stifling for me. So many direct orders that I can do nothing but obey.
Celebrations in Smoke#382.dst: 軍の暮らしは息が詰まりました。直接の命令ばかりで、従う以外に何もできない。
Celebrations in Smoke#382.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#383.src: And it was so boring. Most of my time was spent standing still, watching for threats that never came.
Celebrations in Smoke#383.dst: それにとても退屈でした。ほとんど立ちっぱなしで、来ない脅威を見張るだけ。
Celebrations in Smoke#383.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#384.src: So I left. I wish them all the best and apologize to Her Majesty for my inability to serve her as I wanted to, but my time soured me on the whole affair.
Celebrations in Smoke#384.dst: だから去りました。皆の幸運を祈り、望む形で仕えられなかったことを女王陛下にお詫びします。ですが、もうすっかり嫌気が差したのです。
Celebrations in Smoke#384.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#385.src: Oh, I see you're getting better at this.
Celebrations in Smoke#385.dst: あら、上達してきましたね。
Celebrations in Smoke#385.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#386.src: Yes, the other reason I left was the brutality of it. I do not handle blood well and was unprepared for the amount of blood I would see.
Celebrations in Smoke#386.dst: ええ、もう一つの理由は残虐さです。血が苦手で、あれほどの血を見る覚悟はありませんでした。
Celebrations in Smoke#386.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#387.src: Most of the time, being a soldier is dull. Mind numbingly so. But the few times it was not made me wish more than anything in the world that I could be bored.
Celebrations in Smoke#387.dst: 兵士の毎日はほとんどが退屈です。頭が麻痺するほど。でも退屈でなかった数回は、何よりも退屈に戻りたいと願いました。
Celebrations in Smoke#387.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#388.src: I'm not even sure the violence was wrong, I just cannot participate in it.
Celebrations in Smoke#388.dst: 暴力が悪だとも言い切れません。ただ、私には加われない。
Celebrations in Smoke#388.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#389.src: Unpleasant life at home. There was nothing for me to stay behind for. The military seemed like my best way out.
Celebrations in Smoke#389.dst: 家での暮らしがつらかった。残る理由もなく、軍が一番の逃げ道に思えました。
Celebrations in Smoke#389.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#390.src: I think I would make the same choice again, even knowing how it would end. There's no way I could stay there for much longer.
Celebrations in Smoke#390.dst: 結末を知っていても、同じ選択をすると思います。あそこにはとても長くいられなかった。
Celebrations in Smoke#390.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#391.src: Of course, I'll talk about whatever you want.
Celebrations in Smoke#391.dst: もちろん、何でもお話しします。
Celebrations in Smoke#391.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#392.src: Let me look at that more closely.
Celebrations in Smoke#392.dst: もっとよく見せてください。
Celebrations in Smoke#392.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#393.src: No, I don't. The residue smells far more pungent than any drink I recognize.
Celebrations in Smoke#393.dst: いいえ。残り香は、知っているどの飲み物よりずっと刺激臭がします。
Celebrations in Smoke#393.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#394.src: If you found it here, you could try asking around the festival to see if anyone else recognizes it.
Celebrations in Smoke#394.dst: ここで見つけたなら、祭りで他に分かる人がいないか聞いてみては。
Celebrations in Smoke#394.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#396.src: Well, I can tell you it's not definitely not green tea. Not sure beyond that.
Celebrations in Smoke#396.dst: まあ、絶対に緑茶じゃないとは言える。それ以上は分からん。
Celebrations in Smoke#396.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#397.src: Hmm... neither of us have seen anyone carrying something that smells like that in.
Celebrations in Smoke#397.dst: うーん…そんな匂いの物を持ち込んだ奴は、二人とも見ていない。
Celebrations in Smoke#397.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#398.src: It would have had to have already been in {p} or they would have had to have arrived even before us.
Celebrations in Smoke#398.dst: 最初から {p} にあったか、俺たちより先に着いていたかのどちらかだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#398.speaker: Aldwell Guard

Celebrations in Smoke#399.src: A broken bottle? It looks kind of like the ones we use for our Bottles of Mist, but the smell is totally different.
Celebrations in Smoke#399.dst: 割れた瓶？霧の瓶に使う瓶に少し似てますが、匂いがまるで違います。
Celebrations in Smoke#399.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#400.src: Whoa, that's super cool! I bet those pointy edges could hurt a changeling pretty bad...
Celebrations in Smoke#400.dst: うわ、すっごくカッコいい！そのとがった所なら、チェンジリングもひどい目にあうね…
Celebrations in Smoke#400.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#401.src: Recognize it? No, but I wish I did!
Celebrations in Smoke#401.dst: 見覚え？ないけど、あったらいいのに！
Celebrations in Smoke#401.speaker: Excited Child

Celebrations in Smoke#402.src: That smell... I don't recognize it, I'm afraid. It certainly doesn't smell safe!
Celebrations in Smoke#402.dst: その匂い…悪いけど、知らないな。安全じゃなさそうだ！
Celebrations in Smoke#402.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#403.src: I don't recognize it. Would you mind putting it away though? The smell appears to be bothering a couple of the foxes.
Celebrations in Smoke#403.dst: 見覚えはありません。でもしまってもらえます？匂いで何匹かの狐が嫌がってるみたいで。
Celebrations in Smoke#403.speaker: Stall Attendant

Celebrations in Smoke#404.dst: うーん。思い出せないな。
Celebrations in Smoke#404.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#405.src: It's vaguely familiar to me, but I'm sorry to say I can't place where from.
Celebrations in Smoke#405.dst: なんとなく見覚えはあるけど、どこでだったか思い出せない。
Celebrations in Smoke#405.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#406.src: Whatever it is though, I certainly didn't bring it here.
Celebrations in Smoke#406.dst: 何にせよ、持ち込んだのは絶対に私じゃない。
Celebrations in Smoke#406.speaker: Festival Attendee

Celebrations in Smoke#407.src: aUm, no, I don't think so.
Celebrations in Smoke#407.dst: ええと、いや、見てないと思う。
Celebrations in Smoke#407.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#408.src: Sorry if you were hoping I had.
Celebrations in Smoke#408.dst: 期待させてたらごめん。
Celebrations in Smoke#408.speaker: Arris

Celebrations in Smoke#410.dst: 見たとは言えませんね。
Celebrations in Smoke#410.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#411.src: There's not much distinctive about it though, except for that odor.
Celebrations in Smoke#411.dst: あの臭い以外、特徴もあまりありませんが。
Celebrations in Smoke#411.speaker: Cerisa

Celebrations in Smoke#412.src: No. And we're in the middle of a conversation, please don't interrupt us.
Celebrations in Smoke#412.dst: ない。今話し中なんだ、邪魔しないでくれ。
Celebrations in Smoke#412.speaker: Clan Member

Celebrations in Smoke#413.src: That bottle? Absolutely not, that smell is much more than what this old body could take.
Celebrations in Smoke#413.dst: その瓶かい？とんでもない、その臭いはこの老いぼれにはきつすぎるよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#413.speaker: Elderly Woman

Celebrations in Smoke#415.src: But they paid me pretty good not to say!
Celebrations in Smoke#415.dst: でも黙ってろって、たんまりもらったんだよな！
Celebrations in Smoke#415.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#416.src: The only way I would is if I were to really be impressed by someone.
Celebrations in Smoke#416.dst: 話すとしたら、よっぽど感心させられた時だけだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#416.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#418.src: Ha! I knew you couldn't do it.
Celebrations in Smoke#418.dst: はっ！無理だと思ったよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#418.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#419.src: No hard feelings, nobody can expect to beat me at fox racing though.
Celebrations in Smoke#419.dst: 悪く思うなよ。狐レースで俺に勝てる奴なんていないんだから。
Celebrations in Smoke#419.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#420.src: Of course, if you want to try again, you're free to. Just don't be surprised when you get the same result.
Celebrations in Smoke#420.dst: もちろん、また挑戦したきゃ自由だ。同じ結果でも驚くなよ。
Celebrations in Smoke#420.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#421.dst: よし、じゃあもう一勝負だ！
Celebrations in Smoke#421.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#422.src: You won!? I-I-I've never been beaten!
Celebrations in Smoke#422.dst: 勝った！？お、お、俺が初めて負けた！？
Celebrations in Smoke#422.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#423.src: I don't even know how that's possible, you looked like you were just picking randomly!
Celebrations in Smoke#423.dst: どうやったのか見当もつかない、適当に選んでるようにしか見えなかったのに！
Celebrations in Smoke#423.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#424.src: Well, fair is fair. You gave me a good show, I'll tell you what I know.
Celebrations in Smoke#424.dst: まあ、約束は約束だ。いい勝負だった、知ってることを話そう。
Celebrations in Smoke#424.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#425.src: It's really not that big of a deal, I'm not sure why they paid me to stay quiet about it.
Celebrations in Smoke#425.dst: 大した話じゃない。なんで口止め料をもらったのかも分からないくらいだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#425.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#426.src: While studying the foxes before the races started, I caught some members of the Kalkalrah clan bringing in bottles like those.
Celebrations in Smoke#426.dst: レース前に狐を研究してたら、Kalkalrah 氏族の連中が、ああいう瓶を運び込んでるのを見たんだ。
Celebrations in Smoke#426.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#427.src: I thought they were just green tea, but clearly they're not!
Celebrations in Smoke#427.dst: ただの緑茶だと思ってたけど、どう見ても違うな！
Celebrations in Smoke#427.speaker: Racing Expert

Celebrations in Smoke#428.src: I'm not positive where they are now, but I think I saw them head up the zipline to the second floor of {p}?
